title: Midnight in Motion
blurb: Eight dancers. Three formations. One continuous performance. A V, a crossing into two diagonals, and a diamond that lands on the last accent.
prompt: Midnight in Motion. Bollywood fusion, step-touch.

sections.name: The Opening
sections.line: The V holds, with step-touches on the count.

sections.name: The Crossing
sections.line: Everyone crosses into two diagonals. This is where the paths meet.

sections.name: The Finale
sections.line: The lines open into a diamond and land together.

title: Filmi Flip
blurb: Two lines cross the stage, trade places through the gaps, and leave in new lines. The move every fusion set needs, and the one most likely to go wrong.
prompt: One minute of bollywood fusion. Four dancers from stage left and four from stage right form a grid of four by two, then flip lines, then leave in new lines.

title: Dhol Drop
blurb: A wedge drives downstage on the dhol, then snaps into rows. Big dhamaal energy with every landing proved on the beat.
prompt: One minute of bhangra. Four dancers from stage left and four from stage right form a V, then a grid of four by two, then leave.

title: Kuthu Mass
blurb: The parai hits and the floor belongs to everybody. A wedge, a hard block, and mass walks straight at the audience, with every stomp proved to land on the count.
prompt: One minute of kuthu. Four dancers from stage left and four from stage right form a V, then a grid of four by two, then leave. Kuthu step and mass walk.

title: Adavu Fusion
blurb: Bharatanatyam's clean lines meet the circuit. Tatta and natta adavus in exact rows, trading places through the gaps with geometry as sharp as the footwork.
prompt: One minute of bharatanatyam fusion. Four dancers from stage left and four from stage right form a grid of four by two, then flip lines, then leave. Tatta adavu and natta adavu.

title: Kolattam Ring
blurb: Stick dance and clapping circles from across South India, opened up for the stage. The ring stays perfectly round while it turns.
prompt: One minute of kolattam. Four dancers from stage left and four from stage right form a circle, rotate it 90 degrees, then leave. Kolattam and kummi.

title: Raas Ring
blurb: The circle at the heart of raas: it turns half way round, opens into a diagonal, and clears the floor. Every dancer stays exactly on the ring while it turns.
prompt: One minute of raas. Four dancers from stage left and four from stage right form a circle, rotate it 180 degrees, form a diagonal, then leave.

title: Windows Mashup
blurb: Staggered rows so that every face reads from the front, then a ring, then new lines. A full mashup set in ninety seconds.
prompt: Ninety seconds of bollywood fusion mashup. Four dancers from stage left and four from stage right form windows, then a circle, then leave in new lines.

title: Enter, Stage Left
blurb: Four on stage, four in the wings. Lean proves the dancers coming on can never clash with the ones already there. Set out on a grid you can edit.
prompt: Four dancers onstage in row B. Two dancers from stage left and two from stage right come in to row D. Bollywood fusion, thumka and step-touch.

title: Full Squad
blurb: Sixteen dancers, eight from each side, build a four by four block along their own rows. A full team on the floor without one near miss.
prompt: One minute of bhangra. Eight dancers from stage left and eight from stage right form a grid of four by four, then leave.

title: First Rehearsal
blurb: Four dancers, one line, and plenty of room. Start here to learn how counts, sections and proofs fit together.
prompt: One minute, chill. Two dancers from stage left and two from stage right form a single line, then leave. Step-touch and box step.

title: Cypher Diamond
blurb: Six dancers hit a hard-edged diamond on a boom-bap groove, then reset to a line.
prompt: One minute of hip hop. Three dancers from stage left and three from stage right form a diamond, then a single line, then leave. Box step and chasse.
